// Fork of "wave greek frieze 4" https://shadertoy.com/view/4lSfWK

void mainImage(out vec4 O, vec2 u) { O*=0.;
	vec2 R = iResolution.xy, 
         r = floor(6.*R/R.y),                                               // x,y scaling factor for rectangle spiraling
         U = r* (u+u-R)/R, I,                                               // normalized coordinates
         A = r - abs(U);                                                    // x,y distance from borders
    A.x < A.y ? U = vec2(.08 - U.y*sign(U.x), r.y - A.x ) : U;              // horizontal vs vertical parts
    I = ceil( U *= sign(U.y) );                                             // apply symmetry on U. I = row number
    U.x += I.y*.02-.22;                                                     // (improvment:) better corner fitting
    U = fract(U)-.5;                                                        // tiles for pattern
    O += abs( U.y *= 1.1 ) < .5
      ? U.y = dot( cos( 3.* I.y * max(0.,.5-length(U)) - vec2(33,0) ), U ), // spiral pattern
	    smoothstep(1.,-1.,U/fwidth(U)).y                                    // antialiased draw
      : 2.*U.y;                                                             // thin line
    O *= .6 + .6 * cos( 6.3*max(A.x,A.y)/7.  + vec4(0,23,21,0)  );          // (improvement:) *hue
}
